Shared laws, commands and teaching applying to all within the stated audience or conditions. General does not remove covenant, historical, priestly or household limits. Read the existing Transformed, Fulfilled, Unchanged, Everlasting and other classifications alongside each entry.

Some source records still need their audience resolved. These are explicitly marked audience review pending; their provisional filing here is not a claim that they apply universally. Passage groups may contain both shared teaching and personal directions.

General · Personal · Instructions overview

3,869 study records in this view. Entries can overlap; this is not a count of distinct biblical commands. Ordered by the first source book, chapter and verse.

The source wording follows the Saints Greek-English text: the Septuagint for the Old Testament and the Greek New Testament. Headings and application notes are study summaries. Preserve the passage’s speaker, audience, conditions and grammatical form. Source alignment checked 6 November 2026; independent critical-Greek review remains in progress.

S064 · The Day of Atonement

Source wording · Saints Greek-English

This is the cited study context; the record does not identify a separate primary command passage.

16:29 And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, humble your souls, and you shall do no work, neither the native nor the resident foreigner who is attached unto you.

16:30 For on this day he shall make atonement for you, to cleanse you from all your sins before the Lord; and you shall be cleansed.

16:31 It shall be a Sabbath of Sabbaths, a rest unto you; and you shall humble your souls: an everlasting statute.

16:32 The priest whom they anoint and whose hands they consecrate to serve as priest after his father shall make atonement. He shall put on the linen robe, a holy robe,

16:33 and he shall make atonement for the Holy of Holies, and for the Tent of Testimony and the altar shall he make atonement; and for the priests and for the whole congregation shall he make atonement.

16:34 And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the sons of Israel from all their sins; it shall be done once in the year, as the Lord directed Moses.

Leviticus 16:29–34

Audience: Shared instruction or study teaching. Read the original audience, conditions and existing classification before applying it.

Topic: Sabbath, appointed times and remembrance

Connection to Christ: Hebrews explicitly relates the annual sanctuary rite to Christ’s decisive offering and entrance; this mark does not decide every commemorative practice. Christian response today: Draw near through Christ with repentance and confidence, hold fast to hope, and encourage love and good works in the gathered community.
